title: 床置きタンク式洋便器
description: 公共施設や店舗のトイレ内装用の洋便器。見える凹型排出口付きの中空の陶器鉢、開口のある便座、上げた蓋、ヒンジ、給水タンクと背面接続外装を造形。床・壁、水・汚物、内部のトラップ・配管、洗浄や蓋開閉はなく、衛生・給排水基準の適合は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.440 × 1.013 × 0.823 m、7,500三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A cistern toilet for public-building and retail washroom interiors, with a hollow ceramic bowl and visible recessed outlet, open-center seat, raised lid, hinges, cistern and rear fitting exteriors. Floor, wall, water, waste, internal trap/plumbing, flushing and lid movement are absent; hygiene and plumbing-standard compliance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.440 × 1.013 × 0.823 m; 7,500 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
